item.title: 24 HOUR ALCOHOL
item.description: Kansas bars and hotels may be able to serve alcohol around the clock during the 2026 FIFA World Cup under legislation a state senator plans to introduce. According to the Kansas Restaurant and Hospitality Association, Senator Adam Thomas will propose allowing licensed establishments to operate 24 hours a day throughout the tournament. item.title: MARRIAGE LICENSED AGE
item.description: The age of consent for marriages in Kansas may change soon if newly introduced legislation is approved by lawmakers. A bipartisan group of representatives introduced a new bill that would set the age of consent for marriages in Kansas at 18 years of age. item.title: PAOLA TRUCKING COMPANY CHANGES HANDS
item.description: PGT Trucking, Inc., which is based in Pennsylvania, recently acquired the Paola-based Debrick Truck Line Co. item.title: Brenda Pearl May
item.description: Brenda Pearl May, age 72, passed away peacefully in her home in Ottawa, Kansas on January 26, 2026, surrounded by her loving family.
